# GitHub Discussions

Turn Discussions on when the gallery opens: Settings, General, Features, Discussions.
Then create these categories (Discussions, the pencil next to Categories):

| Category | Format | For |
|---|---|---|
| Ideas | Open-ended discussion | Apps people want; vote with a thumbs-up |
| Show and tell | Open-ended discussion | Share an app you built, before or after a pull request |
| Q&A | Question / Answer | How do I...? Mark the answer that worked |
| Reviews | Open-ended discussion | Write-ups of apps you use: what works, what does not |

Delete the default "General", "Polls" and "Announcements" categories, or keep
Announcements for the monthly spotlight post and lock it to maintainers.

Comments on a specific app belong on its pull request (or its tracking issue after
merge), so they stay next to the code.
